title: Universal Church
definition: The Universal Church is the whole redeemed people of God from every place and age, united to Christ as one body.
summary: The Universal Church is the whole redeemed people of God across all times and places, united to Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the head of the whole Church and the Savior of His body.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The universal church is the whole people of God in Christ across all times and places. Scripture teaches that Christ has one church made up of all who truly belong to Him.

This doctrine is different from the local church, though it does not replace the local church. It reminds believers that God's family is larger than one congregation, culture, nation, or generation.

Jesus is the Head of the universal church. He gathers His people from every tribe, tongue, nation, and age into one redeemed body.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because believers can become narrow, tribal, or discouraged by the weakness of their own setting. The universal church enlarges hope and reminds the believer that Christ's work is bigger than what they can see.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Love your local church while remembering the wider body of Christ. Pray for believers around the world, resist spiritual tribalism, and rejoice that Jesus is gathering a people no one can number.
